story: In September, Mia and Sam go to a picnic in the park. They bring a small box of chocolate and some cool drinks. Sam sees a big thing in the middle of the grass. Maybe it is a pet for Lily. They never leave anything behind.
title: A September Picnic
setting: A sunny park with green grass in September.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: A young girl with short brown hair and a yellow shirt.

characters.name: Sam
characters.look: A young boy with glasses and a blue t-shirt.

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: A young girl with long black hair and a red dress.

sentences.en: It is a cool day in September.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam are sitting on the grass under a tree on a cool September day.

sentences.en: Mia and Sam begin a picnic.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam are spreading a blanket on the grass for a picnic.

sentences.en: They have a small box of chocolate.
sentences.zh: 他们有一盒小巧的巧克力。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia holds a small box of chocolate on the picnic blanket.

sentences.en: Sam brings forty small cookies too.
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam is putting forty small cookies on a plate next to the chocolate.

sentences.en: The picnic is very easy and fun.
sentences.zh: 这次野餐非常容易且有趣。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam are laughing and eating on the picnic blanket.

sentences.en: Sam sees something in the middle.
sentences.zh: Sam在中间看到了某样东西。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sam is pointing at a strange thing in the middle of the grass.

sentences.en: Maybe that thing is very big.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam look at a large object sitting in the middle of the grass.

sentences.en: The size of the pet is large.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam look at a large dog sitting in the middle of the grass.

sentences.en: They never leave anything behind now.
sentences.zh: 他们现在从不把任何东西落下。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia and Sam are cleaning up their picnic things and looking around.
